newsitem.title: FRANCE: Seven wheat ships expected in Rouen by December 16.
newsitem.headline: Seven wheat ships expected in Rouen by December 16.

text.p: Seven ships are expected in Rouen by December 16 to load some 105,000 tonnes of soft wheat, port officials said on Tuesday.
Destinations for the wheat were not specified, they said.
In Rouen, 14 ships are currently loading a total of 252,000 tonnes of soft wheat destined for West Africa, Algeria, Egypt, Eritrea, Italy, Morocco and Poland.
Two ships are also loading 77,000 tonnes of barley destined for Saudi Arabia and Romania.
